headline: Santander Reports 19% Rise in Third-Quarter Underlying Profit
summary: Banco Santander posted a 19% increase in underlying profit for the third quarter and reaffirmed its financial targets for 2026.
why: Earnings reports from major international banking groups provide insights into consumer credit performance and European and Latin American retail banking conditions.

impacts.name: Banco Santander SA
impacts.why: A 19% increase in underlying profit reinforces confidence in the bank's earnings trajectory and target reaffirmation.
